newsitem.title: JAPAN: Furukawa, Nissho-Iwai to buy RTZ-CRA plant-paper.
newsitem.headline: Furukawa, Nissho-Iwai to buy RTZ-CRA plant-paper.

text.p: Furukawa Co Ltd and Nissho Iwai Corp have agreed with CRA Ltd of Australia to buy a copper smelting plant which Anglo-Australian mining giant RTZ-CRA has in New South Wales, the daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Monday.
Neither Japanese company was immediately available for comment.
The plant has not been operating since early 1995 due to tightened pollution regulations, the paper said.
The Japanese companies will spend more than 30 billion yen to renovate the facilities so they meet the regulations, which would also nearly double the plant's capacity, the paper said.
Currently, the plant is capable of producing 80,000 tonnes of refined copper a year, the paper said.
The Japanese firms hope to start operations at the plant in the second half of 1998, the newspaper said.
It said some other Japanese companies may participate in the project.
The purchase decision was made to meet growing demand for copper in Asia, the paper said.
